title: Kissinger on the 303 Committee overseeing covert operations

tellings.quote: The 303 committee was a secret US inter agency group that oversaw all covert operations and Kissinger was involved with it.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the 303 Committee as a secret group of US government agencies that oversaw all covert operations in the 1960s and 70s, and says the American statesman Henry Kissinger was involved with it. He tells it while asking whether Kissinger oversaw a secret programme to recover crashed UFOs, since such a committee would be one place that kind of work could be controlled.
